verdict_text:
YES

The script derives `scale` and `fan_in_fan_out` from `adapter_config.json`, computes `B @ A` in float32 (both factors are float32), adds `scale * delta` to the float32-upcast base weight and casts back to the base dtype, writes only base keys (adapter tensors are never inserted into `sd`), and asserts all four required checks before calling the sharded writer. The only part not visible here is `_ckpt.save_sharded_safetensors`, which is passed the correct 536,870,912-byte limit and `out/T5` destination.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
